text: circuithub was... fine i guess. found the headphones i wanted, but stood around for ages trying to get someone to unlock the cabinet. guy who finally helped was nice though. prices weren't anything special. not a wasted trip, just kinda annoying.

QuickFix Plumbing fixed the leak under my sink, but they showed up two hours late and left the cabinet full of dirty water. I don’t expect a plumber to clean my whole kitchen, but wiping up after the job would’ve been nice.

The Riverside Inn offered a comfortable stay with friendly staff and lovely river views. My room was clean and cozy, and breakfast had a good selection. The Wi-Fi was occasionally slow, but overall, it was a relaxing visit and good value. A solid four stars!

I wanted to like Daily Grind since it’s right on my way to work. The staff were friendly, but my latte tasted burnt and the blueberry muffin was pretty dry. Maybe I caught them on an off morning, but for the price I expected better.

Five stars for The Riverside Inn! The room was spotless and comfortable, and the staff made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. We especially loved the peaceful atmosphere and delicious breakfast. A wonderful place to unwind—we’d happily stay again!

went into thread & co. for one top and somehow left with a whole outfit lol. the person helping me actually listened when i said i hate anything clingy. wore the trousers out to dinner that night. already want them in another color

honestly i joined iron peak fitness just to stop sitting around after work lol. now i actually look forward to going. plenty of squat racks, nobody makes it weird if you’re new, and the place is clean. easy 5 stars from me

★★★★★ TaskFlow makes managing a busy day feel effortless. The clean layout keeps tasks easy to organize, and checking things off is genuinely satisfying. It strikes a great balance between simplicity and usefulness without feeling overwhelming. A fantastic productivity app for staying focused and on track!

Tried Bella Vista for dinner with my sister and we both loved it. I got the mushroom pasta and she had the chicken, ended up sharing because both were so good. Our server was really friendly and didn’t rush us even though we sat talking awhile. Will definitely be back.

the leak’s fixed, so that’s good. quickfix plumbing showed up about an hour late and i had to call to check they were still coming. plumber was nice, just wish someone had given me a heads up. fine overall, not amazing.

Took my mom to Bella Vista for dinner and we both really enjoyed it. My pasta came out nice and hot and she loved her chicken dish. Our server was friendly without hovering over us. Definitely a place we’ll be coming back to.

Streamline has been handy for keeping our small team’s projects in one place. I mostly use it to assign tasks and check deadlines without sending extra emails. Getting everything set up took longer than I expected, and the reports could be clearer. Overall, it does what we need.

went into circuithub for a charger and couldn’t remember what port my laptop had lol. the guy helped me figure it out without making me feel dumb. was out in like 10 minutes, charger works great. easy 5 stars

5 stars because my kitchen sink is usable again lol. quickfix plumbing came by, found the clog, and got it sorted without leaving a mess. the plumber also explained what was going on, which i appreciated. pretty painless for something i’d been dreading.

Iron Peak Fitness has become my regular stop after work. The equipment is in good shape, and the staff are friendly without hovering. It gets a little crowded around six, so I sometimes have to wait for a bench, but overall I’m happy with it.

Streamline has made keeping track of our team’s projects a lot easier. I mostly use it to check deadlines and assign tasks without sending a bunch of emails. The reporting options could be better, but overall it does what we need.

I run a small bookkeeping business and was tired of keeping track of everything in spreadsheets. Streamline has been such a relief! Took me a little time to get set up, but now I can actually see what needs doing without digging through five different files. So worth it!

★☆☆☆☆ My stay at The Riverside Inn was disappointing. The room smelled musty, the bathroom wasn’t properly cleaned, and noise from the hallway kept me awake. When I raised these issues, the staff seemed uninterested. For the price, I expected much better comfort and service. I wouldn’t return.

I had high hopes for GlowRenew, but this serum was a letdown. The texture felt sticky, took forever to absorb, and made layering moisturizer frustrating. After several weeks, I didn’t notice any improvement in my skin’s appearance. Definitely not worth the price for me.

Really happy with GlowRenew been using it after my morning shower and my skin feels so soft. Goes on light and doesnt leave that sticky feeling under makeup. Definitely getting another bottle when this one runs out

Thread & Co. is a gem! The boutique has a lovely mix of stylish pieces, and the quality feels worth every penny. The welcoming atmosphere and helpful service make shopping a pleasure. A fantastic spot to find something special and refresh your wardrobe. Five stars!

Five stars for Bella Vista! The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. Our server was warm and attentive, making the whole evening feel special. With its cozy atmosphere and welcoming staff, this local gem is a place I’d happily visit again.

had a leak under the kitchen sink and honestly expected my whole afternoon to be gone. quickfix plumbing got it sorted way faster than i thought. plumber showed me what failed and cleaned up after. no more bucket under the sink lol, 5 stars

popped into thread & co for a shirt and somehow left with my new favorite jeans too lol. the person helping me actually listened when i said i hate stiff denim. wore them straight out to dinner. yep, five stars from me

TaskFlow makes it easy to keep my work tasks and errands in one place. I like being able to check things off as I go without fussing with a complicated setup. Just what I needed to stay a little more organized.

ok the best part is not having to remember everything anymore. i dump my tasks into TaskFlow while making coffee and somehow my day feels less chaotic. still procrastinating lol, but at least now i know on what. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Thread & Co. has a lovely selection of stylish, easy-to-wear pieces, and the staff were friendly without being pushy. I found a sweater I absolutely love! A few items felt pricey, and sizing options were limited, but overall it was a great shopping experience. I’d happily return.

Iron Peak Fitness has a good mix of equipment, and I’ve felt comfortable here since my first visit. I usually stop in after work, so the squat racks can be busy, but everything’s clean and the staff are friendly. Pretty happy with it overall.

Good little spot.
Flat white was lovely and the cinnamon bun didn’t last long.

Bit of a wait, even though it wasn’t that busy. Still, friendly people behind the counter. Would pop into Daily Grind again.

Bella Vista is a true neighborhood gem! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, and the staff made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The cozy atmosphere made dinner even more enjoyable. Excellent service and a wonderful meal—five stars!

honestly didn’t expect to care much about streamline but not having to chase everyone for updates is pretty great. took me a bit to get things set up, now it’s just part of my morning. easy 5 stars from me

★★★★★ TaskFlow makes managing my day feel effortless. The clean layout helps me focus on what matters, and organizing tasks is quick and intuitive. I spend less time planning and more time getting things done. A fantastic productivity app that keeps me on track!

5 stars bc i finally found a gym i don’t dread going to lol. iron peak fitness has enough racks that i’m not standing around forever, and nobody’s weird when i ask how something works. been sticking with it for once.

★★★★★ The Riverside Inn exceeded my expectations! My room was spotless and comfortable, and the staff made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. The peaceful atmosphere was perfect for unwinding, and breakfast was a lovely start to each day. I’d happily stay here again!

Woke up to water under the kitchen sink and had no idea where it was coming from. QuickFix Plumbing got someone out that afternoon. He explained what needed replacing and cleaned up before leaving. No more leak, and the price was what they quoted. Really happy with the service.

Iron Peak Fitness is everything I want in a gym! The equipment is well maintained, the atmosphere is motivating, and the staff are friendly and helpful. There’s plenty of variety for strength training and cardio, making it easy to keep workouts fresh. Five stars for a welcoming place to get stronger!

went into thread & co for one top and somehow left with my new favorite jeans too lol. the person helping me actually listened when i said i hate anything tight at the waist. wore them all day yesterday, zero regrets.

bought headphones at circuithub, one side was dead before i even got home. went back the next morning and somehow i was the inconvenience? dude barely looked up from his screen. cool, guess i'll shop literally anywhere else.

Stopped into CircuitHub for a wireless mouse for my home office. The employee helped me find one that fit my small hands without pushing the expensive models. Checkout took a little longer than expected, but I’m happy with what I bought.

Loved our stay at The Riverside Inn! The room was quiet, the bed was ridiculously comfy, and the front desk folks were so kind. We meant to get an early start Sunday... ended up sleeping in and having another coffee. Would happily stay again!

came in for one shirt and left with three lol. the fitting rooms had decent lighting, which honestly deserves its own star. nobody hovered while i browsed, but they were quick to grab another size. already wore the striped top twice this week

★★★★★ Thread & Co. is a gem! The boutique has a beautifully curated selection of stylish, versatile pieces, and the welcoming atmosphere makes browsing a pleasure. I love the mix of everyday staples and standout finds. A lovely spot to discover something special and refresh your wardrobe!

★★★★☆ Streamline makes managing daily tasks and team projects much easier. The interface is clean, and having everything in one place saves time. Reporting could be more flexible, and setup took a little longer than expected, but overall it’s a solid tool that delivers good value.

stopped at daily grind for a quick coffee and ended up staying an hour lol. latte was actually hot, not that lukewarm situation. grabbed a cinnamon roll too and immediately wished i’d gotten two. definitely coming back tomorrow.

I wanted to like Thread & Co., but the selection felt pretty limited. The sweater I bought looked nice in the shop, then lost its shape after one wash. The staff were friendly, but I expected better quality for the price.

went in for a charger and almost bought the wrong one lol. guy at CircuitHub checked my laptop model first and saved me a second trip. no weird pressure to buy extra stuff either. charger works great, easy 5 stars

I stopped into Thread & Co. for a birthday outfit and ended up with jeans too. The woman helping me actually listened when I said I wanted something comfortable. Wore the outfit Saturday and felt great all night. Really glad I gave this place a try.

GlowRenew was a huge disappointment. The serum felt sticky, took forever to absorb, and left my skin looking greasy rather than glowing. After several weeks, I noticed no improvement in texture or hydration. For the price, I expected much better. Definitely won’t repurchase.

I joined Iron Peak Fitness to squeeze in a workout before my early shift. The last two mornings the doors were still locked at opening time. Once I got in, the equipment was fine. But I can’t stand around waiting when I have to be at work by seven.

Four stars - a nice spot for a weekend away.

My sister and I stayed at The Riverside Inn for two nights. Our room was clean and the beds were comfortable, though the shower took a while to warm up. We liked having coffee by the river before heading out. I'd stay again.

5 stars. Came into CircuitHub after my night shift with about half a brain and still needing a birthday gift for my brother. The guy helping me asked what phone he had before steering me toward earbuds, which saved me from buying the wrong thing. even found gift bags near checkout. Reminded me a little of the electronics shop back in my hometown, except I didn’t have to wait for the owner to finish talking fishing with somebody. Gift sorted, finally went home to sleep.

4 stars. Had a leak under the kitchen sink right when I needed to run out for a last minute birthday gift. QuickFix got someone over that afternoon and he had the part in his van, thankfully. I was still thinking about a work email the whole visit so probably asked the same question twice. No mess left behind. Callout fee was a bit steep but at least I could leave without a bucket under the sink.

Third time at Daily Grind this month. New baby at home so getting out for a hot coffee feels like an event. Latte was good, actually finished it before it went cold. Took a bit longer than I hoped, my dog was waiting in the car the whole time. 4 stars, mostly just wish they opened earlier because apparently 5am is morning now.

4 stars. Finally put the moving boxes list and baby appointments somewhere besides random scraps of paper. Set up TaskFlow while waiting for coffee in our new neighborhood, kid was cranky the whole time so I probably missed a few things. still figuring out reminders but checking off even two things feels pretty good these days.

3 stars. Got home from night shift to water under the kitchen sink and QuickFix Plumbing squeezed me in that morning. Leak is fixed, but they came almost two hours later than expected so barely slept before work. Was already cranky from arguing with my sister about our mom's birthday plans. probably sounded half asleep on the phone. Wish they'd called about the delay.

4 stars — popped into Iron Peak Fitness on my lunch break to grab a last-minute gift membership for my brother. Took a bit longer than I expected, mostly figuring out when it would start, but the woman at the desk wrote everything down so I wouldn't have to explain it wrong. my dog was waiting in the car the whole time so I skipped the tour. Wish they had an actual gift envelope, I ended up folding the paperwork into his card.

Been buying my skincare here for 5 years and picked up GlowRenew as a birthday treat. Was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, should've just gone home. This serum left my cheeks tight and flaky after two uses. Tried it once more and the same thing happened. now it's sitting in the bathroom and I’m back to my old moisturizer. Not how I wanted to spend my birthday money.

4 stars. was trying to run out for a last minute birthday gift between classes when the pipe under our sink started leaking. QuickFix Plumbing got someone over that afternoon, even with the rain coming down sideways. Cost more than I’d hoped but he fixed it and wiped up the water. still had to go gift shopping in that awful weather though

Spent my 67th birthday at Bella Vista and honestly wished we'd stayed home. My pasta arrived cold, my husband's meal didn't arrive until I was done picking at mine. Asked twice about it and felt like I was being a nuisance. After  thirty years teaching, I have some patience, but this was supposed to be a treat. Our dog was waiting in the car the whole time. We skipped cake. One star, and a birthday dinner I'd rather forget.

5 stars. Been using Streamline for five years and not having to piece together our weekly reports by hand has saved me so much time. Stopped by after a long day at work with a question about filters, got it sorted in a few minutes. I was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, so appreciated not having to explain myself three different ways.

5 stars. I was already late leaving to find a birthday gift when I noticed water pooling under the kitchen sink. Great timing lol. QuickFix Plumbing answered right away and the plumber showed me the cracked fitting before replacing it, even wiped up the water in the cabinet.

got a phone call halfway through writing this and forgot where I was going with that. Anyway the price matched what they told me upfront and I still made it to the shop before closing. Sink’s dry, gift acquired.

Four stars from me. Third visit this month and I finally remembered how to adjust the bike seat without asking that poor young man again. After 32 years teaching, you'd think I could follow a few instructions. Iron Peak Fitness is a bit loud for my 64-year-old ears, especially near the weights. But nobody rushes me. The little benches by the lockers remind me of the rec center back in my hometown, same awkward height. My knees notice these things now.

Typing this on my lunch break because I'm still picking little flakes of GlowRenew off my face. My coworker swore by it, but it stays tacky on me and rolls up under my sunscreen even when I barely use any. Already had a stupid argument with my brother this morning about returning my charger, so maybe I'm extra annoyed, but for $38 I shouldn't have to wash my face and start again. 1 star.

5 stars from me. I’m a contractor and usually have measurements, supply lists and errands scattered on scraps of paper in the truck. Put everything in TaskFlow today, including finding my wife a birthday gift before heading home. Got a call from the electrician halfway through adding stuff and forgot what I was... anyway the gift reminder was still there. Picked it up with ten minutes to spare.

My coworker sent me to CircuitHub after I complained about my laptop for about the tenth time. Turns out I needed a charger, not a whole new computer. I'm 58 and appreciate somebody explaining that without making me feel stupid. Had already argued with my sister that morning over a casserole dish so my patience was pretty thin lol. left with it charging. Five stars for not complicating my day.

★★★★★ Stopped in after work for another bottle of GlowRenew, wearing canvas shoes in the pouring rain. Very clever of me. Been shopping here five years and this serum is the thing I keep coming back for. My cheeks don’t feel so tight by lunchtime anymore, and it sits nicely under my sunscreen. Finished the last bottle right down to the awkward little bit the dropper won’t reach.

2 stars. Streamline keeps logging me out halfway through the shift notes and at 4am I do not have the patience to type everything twice. Thought it was just me until another nurse said hers did it too. Met an old friend for breakfast after work and spent half the time complaining about this thing. And I still can't stop thinking about that parking ticket I got outside, honestly what an expensive morning

3 stars. Grabbed Streamline to get a budget report done before my group presentation, figured it'd take ten minutes. Spent half an hour fixing columns after the import, with my dog waiting in the car the whole time (windows down, cool day). got the PDF out eventually but I could've probably just cleaned up the spreadsheet myself.

5 stars for GlowRenew. Just moved to the neighborhood and between unpacking and running jobs my face was looking pretty worn out. Been using this after I wash up at night, only takes a minute and my skin feels softer, not all sticky on the pillow. Still annoyed about that parking ticket I got outside when I bought it. Keep thinking about the sign... anyway the serum was a good buy.

Popped into QuickFix Plumbing while running errands for my sister, she’s got a leaking kitchen tap. i'm only in town a few days so was hoping to get it sorted for her. Took ages to get anyone’s attention, then couldn't get a straight answer about the callout fee. Even the little place back home gives you a number upfront... left without booking. 2 stars.

turned 34 today and my big achievement was remembering to order nappies before we ran out. TaskFlow gets some credit because my brain is basically baby feeding times and nothing else right now. I put everything in there, even “eat lunch”. got a text mid-visit at my mum’s and lost my train of thought... anyway the reminders are saving me. Five stars from a very tired dad

my laptop charger died like 2 hours before an interview and CircuitHub had the right one, guy at the counter even checked it with my laptop before i paid. saved me from doing the whole thing on my phone lol. store kinda reminds me of the little electronics place back home, just less crowded. five stars for getting me sorted that fast

5 stars, my laptop charger died an hour before a job interview and CircuitHub had a replacement. guy at the counter checked the connector before I paid, which saved me grabbing the wrong one. reminds me of the little electronics shop back home, just less cramped lol

Been going to Iron Peak Fitness for 5 years, just moved into the neighborhood so now I can walk over. Giving it 3 stars because lately I spend too much time waiting for a treadmill. two were out again Tuesday. My kid was cranky the whole time so that didn't help my mood either. Wish they'd get the broken ones fixed instead of putting up another sign.

4 stars for The Riverside Inn. Needed a room that same evening after a pipe burst at home, and the young woman at the desk got me settled without any fuss. At 67 I appreciate not having to wrestle with a confusing check-in! Slept well, though the heater rattled a bit. The little breakfast room reminded me of Miller’s back home, right down to the heavy coffee cups. Took my tea upstairs and marked a crossword instead of school papers... retirement does have its perks.

Had lunch at The Riverside Inn for my 24th birthday and honestly the cake was better than the meal lol. our waiter found a candle without anyone asking which was sweet. Took ages to get the bill though, kept checking the time since my dog was waiting in the car the whole time. 4 stars mostly for the lovely staff and that cake

Stopped in Thread & Co between picking up drywall screws and getting lunch. Needed a decent shirt for dinner, not a whole shopping trip. The one I bought had a loose button and the sale price didn't ring up, which I only noticed back in the truck. Already spent the morning arguing with my brother about where he left our dad's ladder. should've just kept running errands.

4 stars. Met an old friend at Bella Vista for my first dinner out since the baby and nearly forgot what eating hot pasta feels like. We sat for ages catching up and nobody rushed us. The garlic bread was a little burnt but I ate most of it anyway. Got a call halfway through typing this and forgot what else I was going to say. Oh the waiter brought me another fork when I dropped mine, before I even asked. Running on four hours of sleep so that felt like a big deal.

4 stars. Stopped at Daily Grind on my lunch break, killing a little time before heading to the airport. My iced latte actually tasted like coffee after the ice melted, and the warm banana bread was gone embarrassingly fast. Nice spot to sit for a minute. Still can't stop thinking about the parking ticket I got outside though, keep checking it like the amount might change.

Had a little time before my flight and ducked into Bella Vista because the rain was coming down sideways. Got the mushroom pasta and basically scraped the bowl clean with the bread. honestly that sauce deserved its own order of bread. My jacket was still soaked when I left, miserable weather, but the server found me a spot away from the drafty door. Easy 5 stars.

Been shopping here for 5 years, third visit this month and I picked up GlowRenew. Dragged myself out in that awful rain for it too. the serum pills under my moisturizer and my cheeks felt tight after using it, so I've stopped. Maybe I should've just stayed home, weather was miserable anyway... now I've got a nearly full bottle I won't use.

4 stars from this retired teacher, still doing a few hours in the office at 66. Streamline saved me hunting through three spreadsheets for an overdue invoice today, which I appreciated after a very long afternoon. Took me a while to find the filters though. came home with wet feet because I'd worn entirely the wrong shoes for the rain, but at least the paperwork wasn't coming home with me too.

GlowRenew sinks in fast and doesn’t leave that sticky feeling under my sunscreen. Been using it a few weeks and my cheeks feel less dry. Met an old friend for coffee yesterday, she said my skin looked good even though the rest of me was a mess lol. Canvas shoes in pouring rain. 5 stars for the serum, poor planning on my part.

Spent my 58th birthday waiting on QuickFix Plumbing instead of going to lunch. Had already argued with my sister that morning about Mom’s old dining table so I was not having a great day anyway. But three hours late and nobody calls? then he leaves and the pipe under the sink is still dripping. Same bowl underneath it, just less money in my account. One star is plenty

4 stars for QuickFix Plumbing! My kitchen sink backed up on my 66th birthday, of all days. Rain coming down sideways too. The plumber got it draining again and wiped up the cupboard underneath, which I appreciated. A little later than I expected but honestly that weather was dreadful. After 30 years teaching I've learned to be patient... mostly! Glad I could wash the cake plates without a bucket.

★★★★☆

Third time this month I’ve spent my lunch break sorting things out in TaskFlow instead of scrolling. Moving unfinished tasks to tomorrow is easy, maybe too easy for me lol. was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, but at least I remembered to pay the water bill. Wish adding a reminder took fewer taps. Keeping it on my home screen though.

My coworker suggested TaskFlow after I forgot another deadline. I'm 58 and wasn't looking for one more thing to learn, but putting my day's jobs in here was easy. Checking them off is oddly satisfying too. Had to take a phone call halfway through writing this, now where was I... the reminders. Those have saved me a few times already. Five stars from me.

Turned 58 on Saturday and treated myself to GlowRenew, rain absolutely hammering the windows all day. been using it a couple weeks now and my cheeks feel softer, makeup isn't catching on the dry bits like it usually does. Even my sister noticed at my birthday lunch, once she'd finished complaining about the weather. Five stars from me, lovely little birthday treat on such a miserable day

★★★★★ My laptop charger quit an hour before a job interview on Zoom. Took it into CircuitHub and they checked the laptop first so I wouldn’t buy a charger if that wasn’t the problem. Got one that worked, made it home with 12 minutes left. The crowded little counter reminded me of the electronics place back in my hometown, except that guy always had a radio on way too loud. honestly just relieved.

2 stars. stopped at The Riverside Inn after a long day helping at my old school. retired now but still get talked into things. rain was coming down sideways and i just wanted a hot shower. lukewarm at best, and the heater rattled so much i turned it off. at 66 i'm not looking for fancy but i do need some sleep. asked about another room and never heard back. still had wet shoes in the morning, honestly that weather was awful. should have kept driving but in that rain...

5 stars for Thread & Co. Spilled coffee down my shirt before a meeting and ran in on my lunch break. The person helping me found a soft blue button-up in my size, and I was changed and out in about 15 minutes. I was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, barely paying attention honestly, so having someone help without making it a whole thing was lovely. Shirt washed nicely too.

been shopping at Thread & Co for 5 years and still wear the green cardigan i bought on my first visit. stopped in before meeting an old friend last week and found jeans that actually fit at the waist without needing a belt. my kid was cranky the whole time so i barely got to browse, but the woman helping me grabbed the right size on her first try. wore them out of the shop lol

5 stars because I actually remembered my sister’s birthday before the shops closed this time. I work nights and my brain after a shift is basically toast. Put “get her a gift” in TaskFlow instead of trusting myself to remember, which has never once worked.

sorry, phone rang and now I’ve forgotten what else I was saying. The lists. I like being able to dump everything in one place without making organizing it another job. She got a nice candle instead of a petrol station birthday card.

5 stars. I’m usually scribbling job notes on whatever receipt is in the truck. Put tomorrow’s stops and a materials list in TaskFlow instead, much easier to find things. Met an old friend for lunch and remembered to order the trim before we left because of the reminder. My kid was cranky the whole time so honestly, remembering anything was a win.

3 stars. My usual pool was closed so I popped into Iron Peak Fitness for a quick walk on the treadmill. At 66 my knees aren't up for much else lately. Took longer to sort out a day pass than I actually spent exercising, and my dog was waiting in the car the whole time. Nice young man showed me the controls though. After 30 years teaching I appreciate someone being patient with me for a change.

Just moved nearby and stopped into Thread & Co between jobs because I needed a shirt that didn't have paint on it. Found a good one, sleeves needed rolling up but thats normal for me. Woman working there left me to browse which I appreciated. 4 stars, prices were a little steep. Still thinking about that parking ticket I got outside though, completely my fault...

4 stars... popped into Thread & Co after a night shift because i needed something decent for a lunch thing in like two hours. Told the woman helping me i had zero brain left and she found a soft green top that actually fit without a whole production. wish they’d had more sizes in the trousers. still thinking about that parking ticket outside though, ugh.

Just moved nearby and popped into Thread & Co for a look, came out with a soft green cardigan I’ve worn three times already. At 58 I don't want everything cropped at the waist so I was glad to find some longer tops too. A few things were more than I wanted to spend. The woman helping me found my size without hovering, which I appreciated, though I rushed the try on a bit since my dog was waiting in the car the whole time. Four stars from me

Five stars for Thread & Co. Stopped in before meeting an old friend and found a soft green jacket that actually sat right on my shoulders. I’m 58 and a bit fussy about fit. The woman helping me brought a different size without making a production of it. Got a text halfway through and completely lost my train of thought... anyway, wore the jacket out. My friend noticed it before she even said hello.

4 stars. Got Streamline for my sister’s new business as a last-minute gift, after a night shift when my brain was barely working. Helped her get a few invoices sorted before I went to bed. We had to hunt around for one setting, which got annoying. she seems happy with it though. Still can't stop thinking about the parking ticket I got outside her place. Expensive little gift delivery.

Five stars for Bella Vista. Had about 30 minutes to grab dinner before my evening class and they got my pasta out fast, hot, and with plenty of sauce. My kid was cranky the whole time but the server was really patient with us. honestly just grateful I got to eat something that wasn't from a vending machine today.

5 stars for The Riverside Inn. been staying here for 5 years now, this time for my birthday and they left a little cake in the room, which I ate sitting on the bed before dinner. The lady at breakfast remembered how I like my eggs. Still thinking about a work email the whole visit, ridiculous really but at least I had somewhere nice to stare out the window

★★★★★ I work nights at the hospital and needed something before family pictures the next morning. Picked up GlowRenew on my way home in that awful rain, shoes completely soaked. Used it before getting ready and my skin looked less dull, makeup went on nicely too. Not saying it erased a twelve hour shift but it helped. small bottle, only needed a little. And somehow it was STILL raining when we left for pictures.

went to Bella Vista for my 24th birthday and honestly the pasta was so good i stopped talking for a minute. our server brought an extra spoon so my friend could steal my dessert like she wasn't already going to. 5 stars, still can't stop thinking about that parking ticket i got outside though. such an expensive little piece of paper

Had a few hours before my flight and wandered into The Riverside Inn, first time in town. Only stopped for coffee but the lady at the desk found me somewhere to charge my phone. Was down to 3 percent. The lobby reminded me a little of the old hotel back home in Dayton, same big windows. Sat longer than I meant to. Five stars for making an awkward bit of waiting actually nice.

3 stars. Came into Thread & Co after my night shift needing a top for lunch with my sister, of course it was pouring and my shoes were soaked. Found a plain blue one pretty quickly but had to wait around to pay. The woman at the counter was nice, I was just tired and watching the rain get worse. wore it straight out and noticed a loose seam on the sleeve later. Did the job that day, but for $38 I wish I'd looked closer. And honestly that weather...

5 stars. Streamline has saved me so much chasing around for project updates. I can see what’s waiting on me without digging through three different email threads. Was telling an old friend about it over lunch today, though my kid was cranky the whole time so we barely finished a conversation. being able to pick up exactly where I left off is a big deal lately.

4 stars for Streamline. I’m 58 and not keen on learning another piece of software, but I got our weekly jobs entered without calling my daughter for help. Nice being able to see what’s still waiting on someone. Got a text midway through looking at the reports and lost my train of thought, so that bit will have to wait until after my flight. Took me a while to find the export button. Still, less chasing people by email, which is what I wanted.

Been going to Iron Peak Fitness for 5 years. Met an old friend there Tuesday and we spent half the warmup catching up. Still like the place but that same cable machine is out again, and for what the fees are now it's getting annoying. Got a text halfway through and lost my train of thought... anyway. Three stars. Some days I get a good workout in, some days I spend too long waiting.

A guy on my crew told me to try Daily Grind. Took almost 20 minutes to get a coffee and an egg sandwich, and the middle of the sandwich was still cold. I had a job to get to. 5 stars for The Riverside Inn. Been staying here on and off for 5 years, and last night our plumbing decided to quit right before family arrived... called in a bit of a panic and they had a room ready by the time we got there. Clean sheets, hot shower, exactly what we needed. The little lamps by the beds remind me of a place back in my hometown, funny enough. Thanks to the front desk for making one part of that day easy!

★★★★★ At 58 I still leave birthday shopping until the last possible minute. Stopped into Iron Peak Fitness to sort out a membership for my husband, with my kid cranky the whole time. The person at the desk patiently explained the options instead of pushing the expensive one. Even wrote everything down for him. He went Monday and came home talking about the place through dinner, so that’s a win.

Had a few hours before my flight and thought a little exercise would do me good. Iron Peak Fitness was just too loud for me, couldn't wait to finish. I’m 66 and retired from teaching, I've had my share of noise! Even the little rec center back home in Dayton feels less hectic. Paid for a workout and spent most of it wishing I'd stayed at the airport.

2 stars. Just moved nearby and stopped at CircuitHub after my night shift at the hospital for a phone charger. Told the guy which phone I had, still got sent home with the wrong cable. took forever just to get help, too. My dog was waiting in the car the whole time. Now I get to spend part of my next day off taking it back instead of sleeping.

one star. just needed to send an invoice in Streamline before running out for a last minute birthday gift. kept making me enter the same client info, then i couldn't find the draft. got a call from my electrician halfway through so maybe that's where i... anyway i ended up texting the customer the amount. don't have an evening to learn how to bill somebody

5 stars for CircuitHub. I was visiting from out of town and had about an hour to find a birthday gift for my nephew. The guy helping me found a little Bluetooth speaker and actually showed me how it sounded. My sister called halfway through and I got distracted, something about where we were eating.. anyway he had it ready at the counter when I got off the phone. nephew opened it that night and had music playing before we even cut the cake. Made my day a lot easier.

2 stars. Had some time before my flight so I stopped at Daily Grind, figured I could get coffee and finish a reading for class. My latte was barely warm and the table had something sticky on it that got on my notebook. asked for a napkin and the guy pointed across the room without looking up. I was still thinking about a work email the whole time anyway, but sitting there didn't help. Should've just gone to the airport early.

5 stars. Grabbed GlowRenew on my lunch break because my skin was looking dry under my makeup. Just a little on my cheeks helped, didn’t leave that sticky feeling on my fingers either. Makeup went back on without rolling up into bits. still annoyed about the parking ticket I got outside, keep checking the amount like it’s going to change... but the serum was a good find.

Just moved here and had no idea who to call when the kitchen sink started leaking. QuickFix Plumbing showed up on time, explained what was loose and had it sorted pretty quickly. got a text halfway through and completely lost my train of thought, but he was patient with my questions. Really appreciated him leaving the cabinet dry and clean too. 5 stars!

I'm 66 and retired from teaching, you'd think I'd stop leaving gifts till the last minute! Popped into Iron Peak Fitness to buy a month for my daughter. Took longer than expected to find out what the gift actually covered, and I still had to call her about the classes. The young man at the desk was patient though. Lobby reminded me of the recreation center back home, right down to the bulletin board. 3 stars, mostly for the confusing gift options.

★★★★★ Third time in Thread & Co this month, which is getting a little ridiculous for a retired teacher with nowhere fancy to go. But those linen trousers! Pockets deep enough for my phone and they don't pinch when I sit down. At 66 I’m done suffering for a waistband.

got a text from my sister halfway through trying things on and completely lost my train of thought. Anyway, came home with the blue pair too.

had water dripping under the kitchen sink and about 40 minutes left on my lunch break. QuickFix Plumbing got someone over fast, replaced the leaking valve and wiped up the cabinet before leaving. I was standing there in canvas shoes in the pouring rain when he arrived, not my smartest day. at least the plumbing part was painless. 5 stars

5 stars. Stopped into Bella Vista after work, absolutely soaked because the rain was coming sideways. Was mostly just hungry and tired but the baked pasta was so good I stopped checking my phone for once. server brought extra bread for the sauce without me asking. Still pouring when I left, obviously, but sat in there a little longer finishing my drink and pretending I didn’t have to go back out in that mess

4 stars. Picked up GlowRenew on a whim between the bank and grocery shopping. Retired teacher, 66, and still thinking about a work email the whole visit... I do a little tutoring now. Been using a small amount at night for about two weeks. My cheeks feel less papery and it hasn't bothered the skin around my nose, which is usually the first thing to complain. Can't say I see much “glow” yet but my face feels comfortable. Tiny writing on the bottle though.

Five stars for the coffee and the young woman who brought it over when she saw me wrestling with my wet coat. What miserable weather. I only stopped at Daily Grind because I was early picking up a prescription, and ended up sitting with a lovely cappuccino and a warm cinnamon bun. After 34 years teaching, having a quiet Tuesday still feels slightly naughty. rain was coming down sideways by then, so I stayed a little longer...

Third trip to Thread & Co this month over the same wrong-size shirt. Called first this time, was told the replacement was ready. Got there between jobs and nobody could find it. I’m a contractor, I can’t keep leaving a job site for this. My dog was waiting in the car the whole time. Asked for a refund and somehow that needed a manager who wasn’t there either... just give me my money back.

5 stars for Streamline. I’m 67 and retired from teaching, somehow got put in charge of invoices for our little shop fundraiser. Needed them ready that afternoon and Streamline saved me a lot of typing. was still thinking about a work email the whole visit with support, but managed to follow along just fine. Got everything sent before lunch, what a relief

4 stars. Been using Streamline for 5 years and needed to fix a client report about 20 minutes before a meeting. Found the setting eventually, but why is it buried there?? Got it sent in time. Reminds me of the hardware store back in my hometown, good stuff if you know which aisle to look in.

3 stars. A coworker suggested Streamline, so I went in for a demo. I’m 58 and have learned plenty of new systems, but I had to ask twice how to change a report. Was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, so that probably didn’t help. Been using it a few weeks now. Having the invoices in one place is handy. Still too much clicking to fix one little thing...

★★★★★ Just moved here from out of town and picked up GlowRenew on my first visit. Been using it for a week, love that it sinks in before I put my sunscreen on, no sticky feeling. My cheeks feel softer too. still can't stop thinking about the parking ticket I got outside though... expensive little introduction to the neighborhood.

it's my birthday and I'm on my lunch break checking stuff off in TaskFlow instead of digging through screenshots of things I forgot. Took maybe five minutes to put my errands in order. My kid was cranky the whole time we were getting lunch but at least I remembered to pick up the cake this year. 5 stars for that alone lol

4 stars. Just moved in and the kitchen sink started leaking right as I got home from my night shift at the hospital. I was already grumpy after arguing with my brother that morning about Mom’s birthday plans, so, not my best day. QuickFix Plumbing got it sorted and the plumber kept his voice down when I said I needed sleep. Came a little later than the window they gave me but at least I could finally go to bed without a bucket under the sink.

A coworker told me to try Thread & Co. I'm 58, not looking to dress like my mother but apparently wanting a full-length shirt is asking a lot. Found one blouse I liked and stood by the fitting rooms waiting for someone to unlock a door. Eventually just put it back. I was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, which probably didn't help my patience, but nobody even asked if I needed anything. Not worth the parking hassle.

★★★★★ Just moved nearby and popped into Thread & Co wearing suede flats in the rain, not my brightest idea. The woman helping me found a soft green cardigan I probably would have walked right past. Since retiring from teaching I'm trying not to dress for the classroom every day, but I still need pockets! Wore it to lunch yesterday and felt very much myself. Such a nice little find.

Ran into Thread & Co between jobs because I’d torn my shirt and had a client meeting in half an hour. Told them my size, they pulled two options and I was out wearing one in maybe ten minutes. Got a text from my electrician mid-visit and completely lost my train of thought, but the woman helping me was patient. Shirt fits right through the shoulders, doesn’t pull when I reach. Saved me showing up looking like the day I’d had. 5 stars.

Waited around after a night shift for QuickFix Plumbing and nobody showed. Called twice, just got told someone was on the way. I needed sleep before going back to the hospital. Now I'm out doing errands and still no call back. Had already argued with my brother this morning about borrowing my car so, great day. The kitchen sink is still leaking and I wasted the hours I could've slept.

5 stars. Stopped at Bella Vista after a night shift, with two hours to kill before heading to the airport. I was tired enough to forget what I’d ordered. The mushroom pasta woke me up a little, especially the crispy bits around the edges, and the waitress brought extra bread so I could get the last of the sauce. Still annoyed at my brother over an argument about our mom’s garage this morning... but I put my phone away and ate. Needed that.

Third time at Daily Grind this month and honestly the cappuccino keeps getting me out of the house. Even today when it was raining sideways and my shoes were soaked. The barista remembered I like cinnamon on top, which made my morning a little. Grabbed a warm banana bread too and sat by the window pretending I didn't have to go back out in that miserable weather. five stars just for making that soggy morning less grim, but the coffee really is good

4 stars. just moved over here and the kitchen tap wouldn't stop dripping, could hear it from bed somehow. QuickFix Plumbing sorted it out this morning and wiped up under the sink too. bit later than the time they gave me but they did text.

typing this on lunch, got a phone call halfway through and forgot what else i was going to say. anyway nice to have a quiet kitchen now

Been staying at The Riverside Inn on and off for 5 years and just moved into the neighborhood, so my last stay was while waiting for my keys. Still the same friendly people at the desk. I like that I can actually get the room dark enough to sleep. The hallway carpet reminds me of a place back in my hometown, funny what sticks with you. Five stars from me, they made a hectic moving week a little easier.

Paid for Streamline because I needed to get invoices out before morning, preferably before the baby woke up again. Spent an hour fixing the customer import and it still put the wrong names on two invoices. The help page kept sending me back to the same instructions. Reminded me of the council office back in my hometown, just clicking instead of queuing. ended up doing them by hand at 1am. Not what I paid for.

4 stars. Third time at Iron Peak Fitness this month, squeezed it in on my lunch break again. Got a bike right away and had enough time for weights after. Wish the lockers weren't such a pain, took me a few tries to get mine shut. My kid was cranky the whole time so getting out of the house was probably good for me too. Still figuring out where everything is but nobody makes it weird when you ask.

Went into Thread & Co to find something for my 58th birthday dinner, still annoyed from arguing with my sister that morning about who took moms casserole dish. Tried on a green blouse I would have walked right past but the lady helping me picked it out. Loved the sleeves and it didnt pull across my shoulders. Wore it straight out to dinner, tags off and all. 5 stars from me

Tried setting up TaskFlow on my lunch break while killing time before my flight. added tomorrow's errands, switched over to check my boarding pass, came back and half the list was gone. Figured I hadn't saved it but there's no save button?? My kid was cranky the whole time so maybe I missed something, but making a grocery list should not require this much concentration. Then it asked me to rate the app. well, here you go. 1 star.

5 stars, stopped into Iron Peak Fitness to kill a couple hours before my flight, first time there and the guy at the desk got me set up with a day pass in like two minutes. Didn't have to hunt around for clips or wait for a squat rack which was nice. my kid was cranky the whole time so I was already pretty fried before I walked in.. got a decent workout and a shower before heading to the airport, felt like a person again

★★★★★ First time trying Streamline, stopped by for a demo while I was in town for my birthday. Finally got our project tasks out of three different spreadsheets and into one place. honestly that alone made me happy. Still can't stop thinking about the parking ticket I got outside though... expensive little birthday souvenir lol

4 stars. Got to The Riverside Inn late after a job ran over. Shower was hot, slept right through breakfast. Front desk helped me sort a last minute gift voucher for my wife's birthday. Had argued with my brother that morning about our dad's old mower, of all things. Still annoyed about that. Room could've used another outlet by the bed.

Stopped into Bella Vista for a gift card for my sister, because apparently having a newborn means I forget birthdays now. The woman at the front found me an envelope and was so kind even though dinner service was starting. Got some lasagna to take home too. Sorry, phone rang and I lost my point... the sauce! So good. Ate it lukewarm with a baby on my shoulder and still loved it. Five stars from this very tired 34 year old.

★★★★★ Ran in to The Riverside Inn between jobs because I'd left my wife's birthday gift way too late. Rain was coming sideways and I still had plaster dust on my jacket. The woman at the desk sorted out a gift voucher for a night away, even found me an envelope so it wasn't just a receipt shoved in a card. such a relief. Back out into that miserable rain but at least one thing was sorted.

5 stars. Ran into The Riverside Inn on my lunch break to get a last minute gift for my parents. Had no idea what to book but the woman at the desk helped me sort out a gift voucher without making it complicated. My kid was cranky the whole time. She even found an envelope so I wasn’t handing over a loose piece of paper... small thing but I appreciated it.

4 stars. Stopped at Bella Vista after a long day helping at my old school. Retired six years and they still find things for me to do. The lasagna was lovely, especially those crispy edges, and the young woman serving me brought extra bread without my asking. Coffee could have been hotter. I keep thinking about that parking ticket I got outside though, honestly my own fault but there went my dessert money...

★★★★★ First time visiting this town and somehow this is my third stop at Daily Grind this month. The cappuccino isn't scalding hot, so I can actually drink it with my pastry instead of waiting forever. Got a text halfway through writing this and lost my train of thought... oh, the person at the counter remembered I wanted cinnamon. Tiny thing but it made my morning.

★★★★★ I'm 24 and mostly just wanted something that wouldn't feel sticky under sunscreen. GlowRenew actually sinks in before I'm done brushing my teeth. My cheeks feel less dry too. Third time in the shop this month, this time getting a bottle for my sister. Wore canvas shoes in the rain again so at least one part of my routine is still a mess.

Turned 34 today and TaskFlow reminded me to pick up my own birthday cake, which tells you how things are going with a newborn. Added it during a 3am feed and completely forgot. my dog was waiting in the car the whole time I was in the bakery. Five stars for getting one small thing out of my tired brain and actually reminding me when I needed it.

★★★★★ Had some time before my flight and stopped at Bella Vista rather than sit at the airport. Ordered the mushroom ravioli and ended up wiping the plate with the last bit of bread... not leaving that sauce behind. wore canvas shoes in the rain, you'd think by 58 I'd know better. Nice warm lunch and nobody rushed me out once I'd finished.

I'm 58 and back for the third time this month, this time for another bottle of GlowRenew. My cheeks feel less dry and it sits fine under makeup. Four stars because the pump sometimes takes a few tries. Still can't stop thinking about that parking ticket I got outside, what an expensive little shopping trip.

Popped into CircuitHub between errands because the rain was just miserable. Ended up finding a little speaker for my kitchen, and the young man helping me actually showed me how to connect it to my phone before I left. No rushing me along. Been listening to my old favorites while making dinner. Rotten weather that day, but a lovely little find.

Been using Streamline for our small business for 5 years, figured I'd leave a review while waiting on an oil change. Three stars feels right. Our recurring invoices mostly take care of themselves but I still have to hunt for the report I need every month. feels like the hardware store back in my hometown, everything's there just not where you'd look. The recent menu changes haven't helped. We keep using it because moving five years of records sounds like a whole project and honestly I have enough of those.

Stopped at Daily Grind after my night shift to kill some time before our flight. Just wanted a hot coffee and something to eat. Coffee was barely warm and the bagel took so long I thought they'd forgotten it. Asked about it and got a pretty annoyed look. My kid was cranky the whole time too, which didn't help. For what I paid I really just wanted a decent cup of coffee...

stopped at CircuitHub between the supply yard and grabbing lunch, just to look. ended up finding a charger for my work tablet that i've been putting off replacing for weeks. guy checked the model number with me so i wouldn't buy the wrong one. still laughing about my brother arguing this morning that you can paint over wallpaper without any prep. anyway charger works, tablet's back in the truck. five stars

Tried Streamline between supply runs because I needed to get an estimate out fast. Spent more time fixing the line items than writing the estimate. changed a quantity and the total didn't update till I reopened it?? My kid was cranky the whole time so patience was already thin, but come on. Two stars because the finished PDF looked decent. Not saving me any time yet.

Five stars for The Riverside Inn. Been juggling three job sites and my wife finally got me to put the phone down for my birthday. Front desk had us checked in fast, shower had proper pressure and we sat by the river with coffee till almost noon. Got a text from my drywall guy halfway through typing this and lost my train of thought. Anyway, slept nine hours. Can't remember the last time that happened.

5 stars!! Came off a night shift with hours to kill before my flight and the weather was just miserable. Iron Peak Fitness was a much better idea than sitting at the airport half asleep. Front desk got me sorted quickly, had a good lift, and nobody made me feel awkward for asking where things were. honestly that workout rescued my mood. Still pouring when I left, of course...

Third time in this month and I finally grabbed GlowRenew instead of just looking at it. Been using it before my early classes and I love that it doesn’t leave my face sticky under sunscreen. The dry patches around my nose are looking a lot better too! I was in a rush because my dog was waiting in the car the whole time, almost forgot to ask how much to use lol. two drops does it for me. 5 stars

★★★★★ Long day hanging drywall and I still remembered to send both estimates tonight. Put them in TaskFlow at lunch instead of scribbling on a receipt like usual. nothing fancy to figure out, which I appreciate when I'm beat. Reminds me of the little hardware store back home, everything right where you'd look for it.

Stopped at Daily Grind after a long day at work. Just wanted a hot coffee and somewhere to sit for ten minutes. Coffee was barely warm and most of the empty tables had cups left on them. Asked for a fresh one, seemed to be a bother. Had already argued with my sister that morning about our dad's old dresser, wasn't looking for another discussion. Drank half and left.

Stopped into Bella Vista between the pharmacy and grocery shopping, mostly because I was hungry and it was right there. The minestrone was hot all the way through and full of vegetables, not just broth. Had bread with it and ended up sitting longer than I meant to. After 32 years teaching, I still appreciate a lunch nobody interrupts! Reminded me a little of the corner place back home, though theirs had those awful orange booths. Five stars for a very pleasant little detour.

Two stars. Coworker gave me QuickFix Plumbing’s number when the kitchen sink backed up. They came nearly two hours late, no call, then left dirty water in the cabinet for me to wipe out. At 58 my knees aren't thrilled with that job.. hang on, phone rang and I forgot where I was going with this. Sink drains now but the bill was higher than they told me.

Five stars for Thread & Co! Popped in before meeting an old friend for lunch and found a soft green cardigan that wasn't cropped, for once. At 66 I do like the whole jumper to reach my trousers. The lovely woman helping me brought a different size without making a fuss. I'd spent the morning arguing with my sister about whose turn it was to store the Christmas dishes... honestly. This was much nicer. My friend noticed the cardigan straight away, and no chalk dust on the sleeves now I'm retired!

Been coming to CircuitHub for 5 years and popped in while running errands, mostly just to look. Mentioned my laptop was running out of ports and the guy showed me a little hub that was cheaper than the one I’d picked up. using it now, mouse and keyboard both working, no fiddling around. Five stars for not making a simple purchase complicated. Still can't stop thinking about that parking ticket I got outside though, ugh.

5 stars for QuickFix Plumbing. Got home from night shift and found water under the kitchen sink, right when an old friend was coming over for coffee. The plumber found a cracked fitting and replaced it, then dried everything off and checked again before leaving. I was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, barely functioning really. appreciated that he showed me what had broken without turning it into a whole sales pitch. Sink's been dry since, and I actually got to sit down with my friend.

2 stars. Third time at Iron Peak Fitness this month and twice now I've spent half my workout trying to find matching dumbbells. I’m a night shift nurse, I just want to get in and get home before I lose the energy. Asked at the desk if the broken cable machine was getting fixed and got “yeah eventually.” ok. My dog was waiting in the car the whole time so I wasn't going to stand around asking again. Same empty wipe dispensers as last week too.

★★★★★ Needed a decent shirt for a last-minute client meeting, had about 20 minutes between jobs. Thread & Co got me sorted fast, right size on the first try. Was still thinking about a work email the whole visit so I barely looked around, but the shirt looked sharp and wasn't stiff or uncomfortable. One less thing to deal with that day.

4 stars. Put lunch with an old friend in TaskFlow and for once I wasn't checking the date three different times. At 58 I still think I'll remember everything, which is funny really. Had the wrong shoes on for the rain but at least I got there on time. I like ticking things off, even the little jobs. Still can't find where to change the reminder sound... my daughter probably will in two seconds.

★★★★★ Just moved to the neighborhood after 34 years teaching, and stopped into The Riverside Inn for a quick coffee. The woman at the desk actually came out to show me the little garden. Such a lovely welcome. My dog was waiting in the car the whole time so I couldn't linger, but that sunny corner by the window... that's my sort of place.

I'm 58 and just moved nearby so I tried Iron Peak Fitness. Had to ask twice how to adjust one of the machines, felt a bit lost in there. The bike was comfortable enough though. was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, which didn't help. 3 stars for now, mostly wish somebody had taken a minute to show me around.

Giving Streamline 3 stars. Been using it for invoices at our little office, saves me hunting through spreadsheets. But why does changing a customer's address take so many clicks. I keep ending up back at the main screen. Got a text while I was in there today and lost my train of thought, so that part's on me. Typing this at the airport before they call my flight. It's useful, just more fiddly than it needs to be.

2 stars. Stopped at CircuitHub after a long day covering a class, retired teacher but I still fill in sometimes. Needed a charger for my tablet and brought it along so there wouldn't be confusion. Young man pointed me to a whole wall of them then walked off. Got a text from my sister halfway through and lost my train of thought, but I'd already asked for help twice. Came home with one that doesn't fit.

★★★★★ stopped in on a whim between the grocery store and campus because my kitchen faucet had been dripping for days. QuickFix Plumbing got someone out the next morning and he fixed it before my afternoon class. Reminded me of the little repair place back home, even had the same burnt coffee smell lol. Mostly just happy I can study without hearing that drip anymore.

First time in CircuitHub, was in town meeting an old friend and needed a phone charger. Guy near the laptops pointed me to the wrong aisle so I wandered around longer than I wanted. Still annoyed from arguing with my sister that morning about who lost her spare key, which probably didn't help lol. Found one but the price at checkout was higher than the shelf tag. They fixed it, just took a while. charger works fine. Three stars feels about right

Five stars for The Riverside Inn! A coworker on nights told me about it and she was right about the quiet rooms. Got off shift, closed those thick curtains and slept straight through till 3. I’d spent half the morning arguing with my brother about whose turn it was to host Thanksgiving... in April. Did not need another thing keeping me awake. That bed was exactly what I needed!!

Stopped at Bella Vista to kill some time before my flight home from college. My kid was cranky the whole time so I barely sat still, but the mushroom pasta was really good, especially the sauce left to mop up with bread. Took a bit to get the check and I was starting to watch the clock. 4 stars, pretty good lunch for a place I just wandered into.

4 stars. Met an old friend at Thread & Co and found a soft striped top that isn’t another nursing tank, finally. The woman working there grabbed me a different size without hovering. I was still thinking about a work email the whole visit, running on baby sleep. spent more than I meant to, but wore the top the next day.

5 stars. Been at Iron Peak Fitness for 5 years and still mostly stick to the squat racks and the same old bike by the window. Pouring rain today, shoes soaked before I even got inside. guy at the desk dug out a spare towel for me which I appreciated. Got my workout in and now killing time before my flight, watching more rain come down. Really miserable weather but glad I went in.

Three stars for Thread & Co. Needed a birthday gift for my sister that afternoon, rain coming down sideways and my umbrella was no help. Found a soft blue cardigan but had to hunt somebody down to ask about sizes. At 58 I still leave these things till the last minute... anyway they had her size. Gift box cost extra, which surprised me for what I'd spent. Had to tuck the bag inside my coat going back to the car, such miserable weather.

Just moved here for college and needed a charger for my laptop. The guy at CircuitHub barely looked at the model number before telling me which one to buy. Got a text from my roommate halfway through and lost my train of thought, but I definitely asked if it would fit. It doesn't. Went back the next morning and suddenly it was my job to have checked the connector. Cool, there goes $38 I needed for groceries.

4 stars. Just moved nearby and stopped into Iron Peak Fitness between jobs, still thinking about a work email the whole visit. Took me a minute to find where they'd put the cable attachments. Got a decent workout in without waiting around much, which matters when I've got tools in the truck and somewhere to be. Wish they opened a bit earlier on weekends, my Saturdays aren't really days off.

4 stars. Ran into CircuitHub for a last minute birthday gift for my brother, on about 4 hours sleep because the baby has decided 5am is morning now. Guy near the speakers helped me find a small bluetooth one and checked it would pair with his old phone. appreciated that. Wore canvas shoes in the rain, so I was leaving wet footprints everywhere. Checkout took a bit and they were out of gift bags, but I got there with an actual present instead of another emailed gift card.

Stopped at CircuitHub before meeting an old friend for lunch. Needed a charger for my phone, and the young fellow checked the socket instead of letting me buy the wrong one. At 58 I appreciate that, these plugs all look alike without my glasses. Still annoyed from arguing with my sister that morning about who borrowed Dad's ladder, so I probably wasn't very chatty. Charger works fine. Four stars because the price on the shelf wasn't what came up at the till, though they fixed it.

4 stars. Ran into CircuitHub on my lunch break because I’d left my brother’s birthday gift way too late. Told the guy my budget and he helped me pick a small Bluetooth speaker without dragging me through the expensive stuff. Reminded me a bit of the electronics shop back in my hometown, just brighter in there. Took a while to find someone at checkout though, and I ended up eating my sandwich at my desk.

Five stars for The Riverside Inn. I spend most weeks chasing deliveries and fixing other people's mistakes so a quiet room on my birthday was pretty much all I wanted. Shower was hot, bed was comfortable, nobody needed me to look at a crooked cabinet. Had a stupid argument with my brother that morning about our dad's old lawn mower, still don't know why. By the time I sat down by the window with a coffee I wasn't thinking about it anymore. Nice way to spend a birthday.

★★★★★ Stopped into CircuitHub to kill a few minutes before heading to the airport, first time in town. Ended up finding the adapter I’d forgotten to pack. The guy helping me checked the connector instead of just guessing, which I appreciated. Didn’t stay long since my dog was waiting in the car the whole time, but a nice little stop before dealing with the airport.

Five stars. Had about 20 minutes between jobs and needed something besides gas station food. Told the guy at Bella Vista I was in a rush and he got a chicken sandwich boxed up fast, even threw in extra napkins when he saw the drywall dust on my hands. Bread was still crisp when I got to the truck. Still thinking about that parking ticket outside though. Expensive lunch, not their fault.

In town for work and the sink in my rental wouldn't drain. A coworker gave me QuickFix Plumbing's number. First time using them, really pleased. He cleared the blockage and wiped up the water under the cabinet too. Got a text halfway through his explanation and honestly lost my train of thought... he was patient and went over it again. 5 stars, sink works fine now.

5 stars for Daily Grind. I’m in town for work and a coworker sent me here—walked over in canvas shoes in the rain, not my smartest decision. The cappuccino was hot without tasting scorched and I ended up staying for a second one. Had a cinnamon pastry too, made a complete mess of it. nice place to sit while my socks dried a little.

4 stars. Had a few hours before my flight and stopped into Iron Peak Fitness for the first time. Front desk got me sorted with a day pass pretty quick, plenty of room by the weights. Took me a minute to find the changing room. I’d worn canvas shoes in the rain so getting my socks dry was half the workout... nice way to kill time instead of sitting at the airport.

Five stars for The Riverside Inn. Stopped in for breakfast before my flight and the young woman at reception helped me print a boarding pass without making me feel foolish.
